messages:
Maria P.: kicking off coordination for CredentialMesh marketplace onboarding — focus: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, KMS/HSM key exchange, and secrets manager compatibility. want a dry-run before the partner demo.
Raj K.: timeline: partner asked for an internal demo 5/18. we should run a rehearsal 5/11. is that feasible?
Olivia S.: security checklist first: HSM key wrapping flow, attestation note, and key rotation policy confirmed. need their KMS onboarding contact.
Sam L.: vendor-side asks: SCIM group sync + mapped roles for 'admin, engineer, readonly'. they want example mapping.
Ben A.: action: I'll prepare a minimal SCIM mapping and a SAML metadata snippet. who owns the playbook doc?
Maria P.: Ben owns playbook. Raj + Olivia to validate. Sam to confirm partner accepts the mapping. I'll handle marketplace listing copy and embargo timing.
Ben A.: SCIM snippet (example) — please sanity check before I send to CredentialMesh:
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "mappings": {
    "externalId": "id",
    "userName": "email",
    "groups": "entitlements"
  }
}
```
Olivia S.: looks ok. add attribute for 'department' and a checksum for optimistic concurrency on group updates. also request they support bulk PATCH.
Raj K.: SAML checklist: we'll need their IdP metadata and expected NameID format (email). sample relay config we use:
```
RelayState: /marketplace/launch
NameIDPolicy: email
AssertionConsumerService: https://console.redwood.ai/sso/callback
```
Sam L.: CredentialMesh rep is Claire. I pinged her earlier — she'll share IdP metadata and a KMS contact by EOD tomorrow.
Credibot: Automated test run (staging) — SCIM create user: FAILED (400) — missing 'entitlements' attribute. See /ci/scim-smoke-22 logs.
Ben A.: noted, I'll update playbook to include fallback provisioning: create user without entitlements and send post-provisioning role-sync job.
Maria P.: ops owners: Raj for infra runbook, Olivia for security sign-off, Ben for partner docs, Sam for partner comms. Can we confirm rehearsal 5/11 11:00 PT?
Raj K.: confirmed from infra side. I'll schedule canary smoke tests + tracing hooks.
Olivia S.: confirmed for security review at 10:30 PT same day (pre-rehearsal).
Sam L.: Claire confirmed 5/11. she'll bring their engineer for the live test.
Maria P.: perfect. last items: embargo/PR window — legal wants 48hrs. mark launch-slot tentative 5/20 and keep 5/22 as backup. I'll create calendar invite and attach the playbook.
Ben A.: will upload playbook draft to the partnership folder and add a step-by-step runbook and sample curl commands for token exchange.
Credibot: Reminder: runbook lint found no blocking issues after update-3.0. Great job. :rocket:
Maria P.: thanks team — moving to action items. I'll post updated checklist once Ben's doc is up.
